rationale: The agent handled authentication correctly using full name + zip, verified the user’s account, identified the two pending t-shirt orders, sought explicit confirmation of the exact change and payment method, executed the modifications with the correct variant (purple, S, polyester, v-neck), and accurately reported the resulting small price differences and updated order statuses. However, the agent earlier answered the initial product-availability question incorrectly, stating there were 11 t-shirt options available when the tool data showed 12 total variants with 10 available (2 unavailable). This constitutes providing unsupported/incorrect information. Despite the order changes being performed correctly and in line with policy, the incorrect product-availability count means the overall interaction did not fully meet the pass bar of providing correct final information across the user’s requests.
